evidence_navigation.denominator: Distinct (public path, SHA256, read_path) keys in all nested current-record citations (including current/historical reviews, corrections and relationships), version-bound transfer evidence, and explicit selected-public-source-index entries. Citation roles stay separate; aliases may share bytes. Counts are not distinct discoveries.

evidence_navigation.unassessed: Unregistered archives, other source-index formats, private/withheld work, scientific completeness and unextracted reusable mechanisms. Metadata-only exclusions retain explicit reasons.

scientific_acceptance: Only explicit version-bound substantive review overlays confer acceptance; extraction and hashing do not.
scope: Scientific lane: all registered current cards, atlas entries, selected reusable units and latest technology, including located proof AND available evidence ranges. Separate evidence lane: current record evidence ranges and explicit selected-public-source-index entries, with exclusions and no inferred acceptance. Unregistered archives/withheld material remain unassessed.
